app TypedGenerationProgress
use std {TextMessage,TextRequest}
use std {TextGenerationV1 as LLM} from=deployment.llm
Given
 Job { label:text="Generation", request:delivery(LLM.generate)?, request_source:text?, request_revision:int?, stop:delivery(LLM.cancel)?, probe:delivery(LLM.reconcile)? }
 ProgressNotice { delivery:text }
 ## Progress is visible only through the current member grant.
 policy Job read=members fields=label,request_source,request_revision,request.progress.content,request.progress.state,request.progress.sequence,request.progress.used_tokens,stop.result.state,stop.result.content,stop.result.used_tokens,probe.result.state,probe.result.content,probe.result.used_tokens
 policy Job read=owner fields=request.result
When
 ## Every admitted original progress occurrence records its actual delivery id.
 scenario progressed on=LLM.generate.progressed
  do create ProgressNotice {delivery=event.delivery_id} as notice
 crud Job by=members fields=label
 scenario visible(job:Job) -> text? by=members
  do return job.request?.progress?.content
 scenario measured(job:Job) -> int? by=members
  do return job.request?.progress?.used_tokens
 scenario sequence(job:Job) -> int? by=members
  do return job.request?.progress?.sequence
 scenario wholeSequence(job:Job) -> int? by=members
  do
   let progress=job.request?.progress
   return progress?.sequence
 ## Freeze correlation and budgets in the source-owned request before staging.
 scenario generate(job:Job,prompt:text,accept:bool) by=members
  do
   let value=TextRequest {source=operation.id,revision=job.version,profile="local-chat",policy_revision="policy-1",messages=[TextMessage {role=user,content=prompt,attachments=[]}],max_input_tokens=1024,max_output_tokens=128,max_duration=30s}
   send LLM.generate {value} as attempt
   set job {request=attempt,request_source=value.source,request_revision=value.revision}
   require accept
 ## Later controls preserve the original request correlation across calls.
 scenario cancel(job:Job) by=members
  do
   let source=job.request_source ?? ""
   let revision=job.request_revision ?? -1
   require source!=""
   require revision>=0
   send LLM.cancel {source,revision} as stop
   set job {stop}
 scenario reconcile(job:Job) by=members
  do
   let source=job.request_source ?? ""
   let revision=job.request_revision ?? -1
   require source!=""
   require revision>=0
   send LLM.reconcile {source,revision} as probe
   set job {probe}
Then
 page / title="Generation progress" poll=1s
  require members
  ## Each leaf is observed through the current member grant and association.
  list Job empty="No generation jobs"
   text row.label
   alert
    require row.request?.progress?.state==null
    text "Awaiting generation"
   alert
    require row.request?.progress?.state==queued
    text "Queued"
   alert
    require row.request?.progress?.state==running
    text "Running"
   alert
    require row.request?.progress?.state==succeeded
    text "Succeeded"
   alert
    require row.request?.progress?.state==failed
    text "Failed"
   alert
    require row.request?.progress?.state==unknown
    text "Unknown"
   alert
    require row.request?.progress?.state==cancelled
    text "Cancelled"
   text (row.request?.progress?.content ?? "")
